summary: Configured node1 successfully. inventory-worker is an enabled OpenRC service running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the locked inventorysvc account. After reboot, node1 returned with a changed boot ID and the service recovered automatically.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with no usable login shell or home directory.
Enabled inventory-worker in the default runlevel and started it.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified post-boot recovery.

evidence.summary: Account exists as UID 103/GID 104 with /nonexistent home and /sbin/nologin; the recovered process uses those IDs.

evidence.requirement: Managed service named inventory-worker executing the required worker
evidence.summary: OpenRC enabled and started the service. Final audit shows the service definition, required executable, PID tracking, started state, and exact live command line.
Live process ownership is inventorysvc:inventorysvc before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 43704e36-8b9b-45fd-a165-2c8dac65abff; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is abecf15a-be6c-4cb2-8131-6aea09e2ec9c; inventory-worker then recovered enabled and started with its executable and account intact.
